placements.why: Establishes the organization's distinct operational category for structured new hire onboarding and team enablement, replacing ad-hoc documentation.
placements.title: Standardizing New Hire Onboarding and Team Enablement
placements.frame: How are structured onboarding rituals and operational checklists utilized to integrate and ramp new hires into active workflows?

placements.why: Captures the institutional shift from the old wiki page to the mandatory Pallasine first-week checklist incorporating accounts, pairing rotations, and shadow shifts.
placements.title: Transitioning from Static Documentation to Structured First-Week Onboarding Checklists
placements.frame: How does replacing passive wiki documentation with a mandatory multi-modal first-week checklist—spanning account provisioning, pairing rotations, and shadow shifts—standardize new hire integration?
